latest_release.name: v0.20261110.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* allow ML-DSA end-entity keys in MTCs by @jsha in https://github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/pull/9154
* Use structured logging for MTC components by @aarongable in https://github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/pull/9152
* Stop requiring RFC6962 logs by @mcpherrinm in https://github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/pull/9159
* Bump to Go 1.27.4 by @jsha in https://github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/pull/9171


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/compare/v0.20261105.0...v0.20261110.0
